title: Build plugins for Claude
summary: Anthropic launched a plugin directory submission portal for publishing MCP connectors and Agent Skills with built-in validation, safety scanning, and usage analytics. The system supports MCP 2.0 including interactive MCP Apps and Enterprise Managed Auth, establishing the primary distribution channel for third-party extensions.

title: Claude Marketplace: one place to discover plugins, agents, and services from our partners
summary: Anthropic launched Claude Marketplace, a unified platform hosting 2,000+ connectors, plugins, agents, and services from partners like Google, Microsoft, Salesforce, and Snowflake. Enterprises can apply committed Anthropic spend toward partner offerings, streamlining procurement for AI-integrated workflows.

title: How Anthropic's sales team rebuilt inbound with Claude Managed Agents
summary: Anthropic deployed a Claude-powered sales agent on Claude Managed Agents to handle inbound inquiries, answering pricing and compliance questions while guiding prospects through checkout 24/7. The agent doubled lead-to-opportunity conversion rates and reduced deal closing time by approximately five days.

title: How CodeRabbit, Power Digital, and ThoughtSpot scale with Snowflake and Vercel on Claude Marketplace
summary: CodeRabbit, Power Digital, and ThoughtSpot demonstrate using Anthropic commitments to purchase Snowflake and Vercel services through Claude Marketplace. By consolidating third-party spend under a single approval process, these companies avoid separate budget requests and streamline procurement.

title: Working at the frontier: How Balyasny Asset Management evaluates and governs Claude Fable 5
summary: Balyasny Asset Management deployed Claude Fable 5 in its BAMAgent platform for financial research, achieving 89.4% accuracy on real tasks and reducing merger-arbitrage analysis time from days to hours. The firm implements governance through data boundaries, least-privilege access, and mandatory human review.

title: Giving companies more control over their AI agents, with NVIDIA
summary: Claude Managed Agents offers composable APIs for production agents with layered security, credential management, and audit trails. Credentials are held in separate vaults inaccessible to agents; NVIDIA OpenShell integration enforces policies outside the model, enabling enterprises to formally verify agent access and set narrow permissions.
